title: Sunken Solarium - Sunsketch Bloom
_note: Option C relit/brightened variant. era gba (richer register, chords allowed, warm reverb). 100 BPM, 4/4, radiant G major, 24 bars. Brighter, more active lead — wistful sighs replaced with lifts. Faster harp-like pluck arpeggio PLUS a soft warm gba pad sustaining underneath for bloom. Warm walking bass with more forward motion. Fuller soft kit + light shaker hat, gentle forward groove. A soft warm counter-lead (pad/triangle) echoes the main lead a bar later — call-and-response. Vesper motif stated in full radiant major (D4->G4->A4 ... B4->A4->G4) then ANSWERED by the warm counter-voice, the motif sung twice, second time brighter: the score reaching toward dawn. ~6 voices (within gba's 8). Last bar D->G pickup voice-leads to bar 1.
